create.name: Rabbi Rami Shapiro
create.bio:
Rabbi Rami Shapiro is a writer and teacher of what he calls perennial wisdom. Judaism is his first spiritual language, but he likens religions to languages: none is true or false, each shapes how its speakers see the world, and the more of them a person knows, the richer their understanding becomes. In the end, he says, truth is found in silence. His teaching rests on four points: that all life is an expression of one nondual aliveness, named in Hebrew Havaya; that every person can wake up to it; that waking up leads to living by the Golden Rule; and that this is the highest human calling.

He is a contributing editor at Spirituality & Health magazine, home of his column Roadside Assistance for the Spiritual Traveler, and he answers readers' questions in a free online column, Ask Rabbi Rami. His many books range over perennial wisdom, Judaism and Jewish wisdom literature, Hasidism, spiritual practice and poetry, and include annotated editions of Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, Pirke Avot and the Tanya alongside titles such as Holy Rascals and Judaism Without Tribalism. He describes his days as given mostly to reading, writing, meditating and walking his dog, and his talks and interviews can be found widely online.

books.title: Perennial Wisdom for the Spiritually Independent: Sacred Teachings—Annotated & Explained
books.author: Rami Shapiro
books.description: Sacred teachings from several traditions, each annotated and explained, for readers who walk a spiritually independent path rather than belong to one religion.

books.title: The World Wisdom Bible: A New Testament for a Global Spirituality
books.author: Rami Shapiro
books.description: His gathering of wisdom from many faiths into what he presents as a new testament for a global spirituality.

books.title: The Golden Rule and the Games People Play: The Ultimate Strategy for a Meaning-Filled Life
books.author: Rami Shapiro
books.description: Sets the Golden Rule against the games people play and offers it as the surest strategy for a life full of meaning.

books.title: Holy Rascals: Advice for Spiritual Revolutionaries
books.author: Rami Shapiro
books.description: Advice for people he calls spiritual revolutionaries: those willing to question received religion in search of something truer.

books.title: Zen Mind Jewish Mind: Koan, Midrash, & The Living Word
books.author: Rami Shapiro
books.description: Places Zen koans beside Jewish midrash and reads both as forms of a living word that unsettles fixed ways of seeing.

books.title: Judaism Without Tribalism: A Guide to Being a Blessing to All the Peoples of the Earth
books.author: Rami Shapiro
books.description: A guide to a Judaism whose purpose is to be a blessing to all the peoples of the earth rather than to guard a tribe.

books.title: Minyan: Ten Principles for Living a Life of Integrity
books.author: Rami Shapiro
books.description: Ten principles for living a life of integrity, one for each member of a traditional prayer quorum.

books.title: The Sacred Art of Lovingkindness: Preparing to Practice
books.author: Rami Shapiro
books.description: A book on getting ready to practise lovingkindness as a spiritual discipline.

books.title: Tanya, the Masterpiece of Hasidic Wisdom: Selections Annotated & Explained
books.author: Rami Shapiro
books.description: Selections from the Tanya, a classic of Hasidic wisdom, with his annotations and explanations.

books.title: The Tao of Solomon: Unlocking the Perennial Wisdom of Ecclesiastes
books.author: Rami Shapiro
books.description: Reads the biblical book of Ecclesiastes for its perennial wisdom, drawing out what it shares with the Tao.
